    • updateCompletedAppointments

      public void updateCompletedAppointments()
      Updates the status of past appointments. BOOKED becomes COMPLETED. APPROVED becomes EXPIRED.

    • modifyAppointmentBySupplier

      public String modifyAppointmentBySupplier(int appointmentId, Supplier supplier, LocalDateTime newStart, LocalDateTime newEnd, AppointmentType newType, int newCapacity)
      Modifies an existing appointment by the supplier. Reverts to PENDING if currently APPROVED, REJECTED, EXPIRED, or CANCELLED.
      Parameters:
      appointmentId - the ID of the appointment
      supplier - the supplier modifying the appointment
      newStart - the new start time
      newEnd - the new end time
      newType - the new appointment type
      newCapacity - the new maximum capacity
      Returns:
      null if success, error message if failed
